metadata.description: Agent skills with self-contained artifacts, sharing one design system

plugins.name: council
plugins.description: Five-adviser decision council: independent subagents, blind cross-review, Chairman verdict, live transcript viewer, plan.md with feedback re-trigger

plugins.name: spec
plugins.description: Technical spec document skill: a technical spec for one feature: behaviour, data, interfaces, rollout, testing; delegates contested decisions to council

plugins.name: system-design
plugins.description: System design document skill: a system design: components, data flow, capacity, failure modes, operations; delegates contested decisions to council

plugins.name: api-design
plugins.description: API design document skill: an API or SDK surface: resources, contracts, errors, versioning, examples; delegates contested decisions to council

plugins.name: prd
plugins.description: Product requirements document skill: a product requirements document: problem, users, goals, scope, requirements, launch; delegates contested decisions to council

plugins.name: diagram
plugins.description: Excalidraw diagrams from a declarative spec: deterministic layout, shared palette, local preview and SVG export
